description: Ministry of Justice Prison Affairs and Constitutional Reforms - Mediation (Special Categories of Disputes) Act, No. 21 of 2003, Order Under Section 8
categorisation: This gazette content is an order issued under Section 8 of the Mediation (Special Categories of Disputes) Act, No. 21 of 2003. It amends a previous order regarding monetary thresholds for mediation cases. This constitutes a regulatory matter involving legal amendments and statutory instruments, fitting the definition of Legal/Regulatory Gazettes (Type 5). While it mentions a minister's name, this is incidental to the legal/regulatory nature of the content, and there are no detailed portfolio responsibilities or government structural changes that would make it a government-related type.
